## Evidence

Parent re-run: uv run --with textual --with pytest python -m pytest tests/test_dashboard_model.py -q -k evidence. test_evidence_needs_you_for_routes_and_integration failed. The n-pass phase still produced a Needs-you integration item with result fail. Two integration-reports for that phase were created in the same second, so recorded_at tied and max() kept the earlier fail report.

## Missing

none

## Reason

The task's code picks the latest integration-report by recorded_at alone. A same-second tie keeps the older fail, so a later pass does not clear the Needs-you item.
